# [Welcome to the Gallen-Kallela Museum](https://gallen-kallela.fi/en/gallen-kallela-museum/)

At the Gallen-Kallela Museum, you will be surrounded by the art of Akseli Gallen-Kallela in the unique cultural environment of Tarvaspää.

In our changing exhibitions we tell the story of one of our country's most important artists, his life and family, not forgetting contemporary art.

Complete your visit by enjoying a treat in our beautiful café, which in summer expands into our museum garden.

[Read more](https://gallen-kallela.fi/en/gallen-kallela-museum/)

[Read more about Akseli Gallen-Kallela](https://gallen-kallela.fi/en/en-akseli-gallen-kallela/)

[Read more about Tarvaspää studio building](https://gallen-kallela.fi/en/studio/)

## Visiting the museum

#### Only guide and assistance dogs are welcome in the museum

### Visiting address

Gallen-Kallelan tie 27,  
Espoo, Finland  
+358 10 406 88 40

### Opening hours

**Tue–Fri 11am to 4pm**

**Sat–Su 11am to 5pm**

Guided tours in English Saturdays 3pm

[You can check café opening hours from this link](https://www.cafezoceria.fi/)

[Exceptions to museum opening hours](https://gallen-kallela.fi/en/visiting-the-museum/)

### Admission

14 € adults  
9 € pensioners  
7 € students, unemployed

Free entry for under 18 year old.

Finnish Museum Card and Kaikukortti.

We accept Epassi and Edenred as payment methods.
